items.headline: Freshman and 3rd-string QB Levi Davis scores winner in 3rd OT in Ohio's 29-27 victory
items.description: — Freshman and third-string quarterback Levi Davis ran for a 2-point conversion in the third overtime to give Ohio a 29-27 victory over Jacksonville State on Saturday night.

items.headline: Creel throws 4 of 5 TD passes to Williams as Jacksonville State beats Eastern Kentucky 49-7
